Put content in Root and constrain its size using host CSS. Root creates the viewport and scrollbars for the selected orientation.

## Usage

```ts
import { scrollArea, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/scroll-area';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/scroll-area`. It [registers](../../registration/) 2 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-scrollarea-root"></a>

### `shadcn.ScrollArea.Root`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.ScrollArea`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"both" \| "horizontal" \| "vertical"` | Default `"vertical"` |
| `scrollbarXClasses` | `string` | Default `""` |
| `scrollbarYClasses` | `string` | Default `""` |
| `viewportRef` | `null` | Default `null` · serializable values only |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `scrollHideDelay` | `number` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |
| `type` | `"auto" \| "always" \| "scroll" \| "hover"` |  |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
